visual_language.style: realistic exterior architectural reconstruction with source-led proportions

quality_gates: recognizable massing before ornament: base/plinth, body, roof tiers, eaves, column grid, openings
stairs require real treads, risers, landings, side cheeks, rail openings, and verified connections to each terrace level
balustrades must break at stairs and reconnect to platforms; never let rails pass through a stair flight
do not add unrelated trees, people, vehicles, water, or filler landscaping unless requested
materials must separate stone, lacquered timber, glazed roof tiles, metal/gold trim, with visible roughness/bump variation
prompt_directives: write the Blender task as a staged exterior execution plan: reference lock, massing blockout, structural connections, signature details, materials, cameras, export audit
name must-have exterior components explicitly instead of asking for a generic realistic building
describe near-view detail targets: eaves, roof ribs/tiles, column bases/caps, plaque/door panels, terrace stairs, balustrade joints
state negative constraints in the prompt: no unrelated landscape filler, no floating plates, no rails crossing stair openings, no single-color plastic materials
ask for at least one close-up audit render of the weakest structural area
soft_constraints: 局部尺寸和装饰允许合理发挥
uncertainties: 未确认的具体尺寸、门洞和房间数量不得当成事实

prompt_quality_package.purpose: Convert research into explicit Blender modeling instructions, not just archived references.

identity_lock.requested_target: 生成一个现实风格地标外观，重点要求屋顶、楼梯、栏杆和材质细节

build_order: freeze target identity and source confidence
block out recognizable massing before small decoration
add structural connections and circulation details
add signature facade, roof, opening and edge details
apply separated realistic materials with roughness, noise and bump
render hero and close-up audit views before export
detail_targets: base or plinth connection to the ground
entrances, doors, windows and facade rhythm
stairs with real treads, risers, landings and rail openings
guardrails split into posts, panels, caps and breaks at entrances
roof massing, eaves, ribs, tile courses, underside structure and finial details
material separation for stone, timber, roof tile, metal trim and paving
negative_constraints: no unrelated filler objects unless requested
no floating slabs, fake painted openings or disconnected parts
no guardrail passing through stairs or entrances
quality_standard: focus on the requested building only; do not fill the scene with unrelated trees or decoration
lock the main silhouette, proportions and tier relationships before adding ornament
model real circulation parts: stairs need treads, risers, landings, side rails and clear railing openings
model guardrails as separate posts, panels, caps and directional breaks rather than continuous rings through entrances
add facade depth: columns, doors, lattice panels, plaques, brackets, eaves and visible joints
add roof depth: tiered masses, ribs, tile courses, eave trim, underside structure and finial details
use material variation: color, roughness, procedural noise and bump so the browser GLB is not a white clay model
render hero and close-up checks for overall shape, roof/eave detail, facade detail and stair/terrace detail
validate the exported GLB before publishing it to the model showcase
